parsed.name: Odin探测器采集系统
parsed.description: 用于实验中高速探测器数据读出与写入的采集系统，负责接收探测器输出并将连续帧写入数据流或文件，常见于同步辐射、成像和其他高通量测量场景。
parsed.description_en: A data acquisition and writing system for high-speed detectors, used to receive detector output and write sequential frames to data streams or files. It is commonly used in synchrotron, imaging, and other high-throughput measurement setups.

actions.description: 观察已写入的数据帧索引。
actions.description_en: Observe the indices of data frames that have been written.

actions.description: 获取已写入的数据帧索引。
actions.description_en: Get the indices of data frames that have been written.

actions.description: 收集探测器数据流的文档和元数据。
actions.description_en: Collect stream documents and metadata for the detector data output.
